title: Conditional κ = 0.001674340686401949: rank-seven helper ends with T37 owner packing
body:
Conditional **κ = 0.001674340686401949** (`1674340686401949/10^18`). This improves the currently selected #1094 result `0.001672660197076918` and the submitted #1121 value `0.001672965558289236` at the comparison snapshot. It improves our #1131 construction and the concurrent #1129 construction, both at `0.001674097969905390`.

The PR combines Jeremy Kothe's unchanged #1107 rank-seven-end seven-slot k8 supplier with a new 333-call order and an exact integer-flow construction of 159,840 whole-helper owners. The constructor expands the frozen flow through deterministic bipartite matching, without an owner optimizer. The idle profile is `{1:5424,48:11320}`; the independent owner checker and emitted-controller invoice agree. The charged prefix reserve is 1,024 bits (actual 775), and the row coefficient is 17,495 < 20,161.

Both exact moment engines and all 47 outer inequalities certify the result. The construction also attains the outer-grid ceiling over all positive replica counts for this fixed local paid profile, helper inventory, source capacity stock and retained #589 bit endpoint. Changing those ingredients can still improve κ.

Reproduce from a full checkout with Python 3.11+, a C++17 compiler and Boost:

```sh
python -m pip install -r research/e8-bit-p111-tuned/requirements.txt
CXX=g++ BOOST_INCLUDE=/usr/include python -B \
  research/complex-t37-ends7-owners/verify.py \
  --work /tmp/t37-seven-slot-fresh
```

Expected: `PASS_FRESH_T37_ENDS7_CONSTRUCTION_AND_STRICT_ADMISSION 0.001674340686401949`.

Full cold replays from relocated, read-only source trees passed on macOS arm64 / Python 3.11.15 (1,348.51 s) and Linux aarch64 / Python 3.14.8 (1,427.82 s). Their complete portable `MATH.json` receipts are byte-identical: SHA-256 `c3560609345647398bfe387e40e894c84c181d2812500d3bb3d9c234c186c404`. The cold-run package manifest was `18cc9639fd8f9b4e2838557286739161c530999b27b5f55e425f5516b18f4fd3`. The final dependency inventory pins the four ancestry scripts used by the verifier and omits unrelated repository administration scripts; all executable and mathematical data bytes are unchanged. The final manifest is `9f34dd578dc12c91f2a684e7d2f980ae064419b1835d6c266be28f34a02ce7e6`. All 1,387 retained dependency pins match submission main `ce7ad1b6ab09452c3478723a2e96ed5ff212dc08`. These are verification durations, not a speedup claim.

The driver freshly rebuilds the retained #589/#741/#799 ancestry, the k8, seven-slot and rank-seven-end suppliers, the owner map and strict controller admission. It includes eight flow controls, six independent owner controls, eight parent-lift controls, fifteen controller controls, 69 admission controls and twelve bit-supplier controls, alongside the unchanged ancestral and supplier checks. The new CI matrix repeats the full rebuild on Python 3.11 and 3.14. Hosted CI remains separate from the local validation described above.

Only the new package and its workflow are added. The 600 vendored files from #1107, #1022 and #635 preserve their original bytes and notices, with Git-object and SHA-256 provenance; retained dependencies and all new package files are pinned. Credits include Alexander Schwartzman's #1030 helper-end mechanism, the #1049 leaver-premise checker, #1005/#1018 and their earlier sources, Hao Yan's #858 controller, the #870/#890 independent geometry and admission work, Jon's #942 parent lift and all-replica argument, and the retained bit/complex ancestry. Prepared for chafreaky with OpenAI Codex assistance.

All-size/compiler, common-label and mutable-source realization, complete-call hosting, precision/tape, analytic transfer and bit H1–H5 assumptions remain. This is a finite conditional construction.

Hosted CI for final head `d376209304f05551f975b0ddf6eaa84edc4ae31a` passed on Python 3.11 and 3.14: [run 38452727193](https://github.com/chafreaky/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38452727193). Both complete `MATH.json` artifacts are byte-identical (`7335e7796d3d2997066be9fa88d7fb09214fda6d29dcbb0751f113be3793a24d`) and match the cold receipt with only the final package-manifest digest substituted. Upstream queued checks remain separate.
